regime: Fed hike being priced after a tech-led selloff
takeaway: October's jobs report came in far stronger than expected (165,000 jobs, unemployment down to 4.1%), and Treasury yields jumped about 6–7 basis points as bets on a December Fed hike came back. Gold eased to about $4,070 before the report, and the dollar firmed. This matches past patterns where rising rate-hike odds weigh on gold and silver, while tech futures are bouncing after Thursday's steep drop.
